import inspect

import solution
from solution import count_Hexadecimal


def test_issue_example_10_15():
    """Example asserts count_Hexadecimal(10,15) == 6."""
    assert count_Hexadecimal(10, 15) == 6  # 15-10+1 = 6


def test_issue_singleton_lower_bound():
    """Range 10 to 10 inclusive contains 1 hexadecimal number."""
    assert count_Hexadecimal(10, 10) == 1  # 10-10+1 = 1


def test_issue_singleton_upper_bound():
    """Range 15 to 15 inclusive contains 1 hexadecimal number."""
    assert count_Hexadecimal(15, 15) == 1  # 15-15+1 = 1


def test_issue_lower_pair():
    """Range 10 to 11 inclusive contains 2 hexadecimal numbers."""
    assert count_Hexadecimal(10, 11) == 2  # 11-10+1 = 2


def test_issue_middle_pair():
    """Range 12 to 13 inclusive contains 2 hexadecimal numbers."""
    assert count_Hexadecimal(12, 13) == 2  # 13-12+1 = 2


def test_issue_upper_pair():
    """Range 14 to 15 inclusive contains 2 hexadecimal numbers."""
    assert count_Hexadecimal(14, 15) == 2  # 15-14+1 = 2


def test_issue_inner_range_inclusive():
    """Range 11 to 14 inclusive contains 4 hexadecimal numbers."""
    assert count_Hexadecimal(11, 14) == 4  # 14-11+1 = 4


def test_issue_empty_adjacent_reversed():
    """Empty range 11 to 10 contains 0 hexadecimal numbers."""
    assert count_Hexadecimal(11, 10) == 0  # empty [11,10] has 0 elements


def test_contract_function_exists():
    """Public interface defines count_Hexadecimal in solution."""
    assert callable(count_Hexadecimal)  # callable check, no arithmetic


def test_contract_accepts_two_arguments():
    """Public interface defines count_Hexadecimal(L, R) with two parameters."""
    assert len(inspect.signature(count_Hexadecimal).parameters) == 2  # 2 params expected


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Count of hexadecimal numbers is an integer."""
    assert isinstance(count_Hexadecimal(10, 15), int)  # 6 is int


def test_contract_deterministic():
    """Same range gives same count on repeated calls."""
    assert count_Hexadecimal(10, 15) == count_Hexadecimal(10, 15)  # 6 == 6
